export_mechanism: Exact canonical source bytes and actual SDK Result postimages; immutable export metadata is separate to avoid recursive self-generation.

source_provenance_validation.scope: Exact current canonical validator and policy; scoped validate_change calls over the frozen token source delta and provenance ledger; no full-reactor/full-repository gate claim

canonical_remote_readback.verification: Every Git blob in the complete canonical module subtree equals the locally authenticated frozen source; no truncated trees

recovery_scope: Both production token classes retain their original sealed hashes. Token tests and receipts were freshly executed; unavailable historical token receipt bytes are not recreated.
